title: Corelib API completion and stub retirement
body:
Wave 5 API completion is in progress, but no production collection or filesystem stub can be marked replaced yet. The normative implementation contract is now complete and validated: Core.Collections rooted typed growth, Core.FS typed canonical adapters, Result<Unit,E>, no legacy namespaces or compatibility fallbacks, bounded 61-target verification, and three-target runtime-kit evidence. Implementation remains sequenced behind functional matrix recovery.

## Remaining

- Rooted Core.Collections backing storage → `corelib-collections-storage-wiring`
- Host-backed Core.FS → `corelib-system-fs-host-backed`
- Complete placeholder/legacy scan and API-shape gate
- Corelib quality CI and pckg publish evidence

**Linear:** [CYB-186](https://linear.app/cybernomad-it/issue/CYB-186/v04-complete-corelib-api-and-purge-all-stubs)
